note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the alate is recorded, the soldier and worker being undescribed; the description is taken from Hagen (1858) and Holmgren (1913), with synonymy, literature citations, distributions and figure numbers omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body reddish brown; antennae, mouthparts, tarsi, venter, pronotal margins and the median mark of the pronotum all pale brown; wings greyish brown. Body length with wings 22.0 mm, without wings 10.0 mm. Head capsule small, flat and circular, about as long as wide, head width 2.09 mm. Fontanelle slightly raised, surrounded by a paler colour zone. Antennae 19-segmented, segment 2 distinctly longer than segment 3. Postclypeus gently inflated, its length far less than half its width. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head capsule including the compound eyes, length 1.03 mm, width 1.82 mm; anterior margin distinctly incised medially, posterior margin nearly straight. The inner half of the wing membrane bears sparse, extremely fine short setae; the media branches at the apical third; a radial trace is present. Forewing length 19.0 mm.
